# dsh-project-forge
English | 中文
**Project Forge (项目锻造模式)** — a DeepSeek Harness agent preset that turns an agent into the steward of
a project: it keeps the project recoverable (local git), traceable (four contracts plus append-only
records), well-organized (layout & naming discipline), and safe to continue after context loss (com
paction recovery), with write guards that hold even when the model does not cooperate.
It ships two presets:
| Preset | For |
| `project-forge` | Full stewardship: protocol, live document digest, compaction recovery, the write

guards |
| `project-forge-review` (in `review/`) | Read-mostly review mode: code review, simple tas
ks, clean-room subagents |
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Bundle plugins take effect after restarting `dsh web`. Then pick 项目锻造模式 / 项目锻造 · 干净审查 in the mode pi
e plugins take effect after restarting `dsh web`. Then pick 项目锻造模式 / 项目锻造 · 干净审查 in the mode picker.
> **Requires DeepSeek Harness >= 0.2.1-rc.** The digest leaves `{{...}}` alone and hands interpolati
on off to `systemPrompt.context`'s `interpolate: false`; older hosts honour that switch on sections
only, so on an older host a document quoting braces fails during prompt assembly (see `CHANGELOG.md`
3.4.0 and `V11` in the negative-knowledge record).
## What the mode enforces

- **A state boundary.** Everything the project keeps for itself — the four contracts, the records,
r

epository's own rules, the concurrent-write claims — lives in one directory (`private/` by
default).

Everything outside it is the **public surface**, written as if the project were
already open source

: portable, no private fact outside a configuration file (which ships an
example twin), no reference

into the boundary. Publishing is then mechanical: delete the
boundary, copy the tree, `git init`.
-

**Local-only git**: never push, add a remote, or rewrite history until the user explicitly asks.
-

**State in three classes**, all inside the boundary. *Contracts* —
`private/steward.md` (the reposit

ory's own rules), `plan.md` (strategy), `done.md` (current
state), `todo.md` (queue) — are inlined *

*in full** every turn: each has a soft budget, and a
budget is a warning threshold, never a truncati

on. *Records* — `private/journal.jsonl` (work
log) and `private/tortuous.jsonl` (negative knowledge:

failed routes and recorded deviations) —
are append-only JSONL, one record per line, never inlined;

only a one-line-per-record index and
the last few journal entries ride the digest and the recovery

message. *On-demand* material
lives in `private/rationale/`. A project whose documents still sit at

the project root is read
there (and its rules at `.agents/steward.md`), so nothing forged before the

boundary existed
breaks.
- **Checkpoint protocol**: close a logical unit → run checks → update docu

ments → one commit. Never commit per command.
- **Layout & naming**: directory/file/identifier names
follow one-word-one-meaning at every level; checked at every checkpoint; the layout guard refuses u

nacknowledged mixed-artifact roots.
- **Parallel sessions**: single document owner, per-file claims
under `private/.forge-claims/`, released on commit, stale claims expire by themselves (10 minutes of

silence).
- **No secrets in git**: refuses to commit credential files outside the boundary (inside

it, a local-only repository may hold them).
[该节后续省略]
## Configuration

Every switch defaults on. The complete reference — all 33 fields, their defaults and what they
do —

is **docs/configuration.md**. `release/check-consistency.mjs` compares
that table against the plugin
schema, so the two cannot drift apart.

What changed in a given version, and what you have to do about it, is in
**CHANGELOG.md** — one entr
y per version, newest first.
The two you are most likely to touch:

## Layout of this repo
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`docs/` follows Diátaxis — one reader need per file: getting-started.md is
the tutorial (install, ve

rify which copy is live, first takeover),
how-to-change-the-mode.md shows how to change the mode its

elf
(protocol text, a guard, a config field), configuration.md is the reference, state-boundary.md e

xplains the boundary (design, export
flow, guard coverage), and init-a-project.md is the how-to for
bringing a project under the mode.

In this development repository the state boundary `private/` is tracked by git (so state is
recovera

ble) and **excluded wholesale by `release/publish.ps1`**, which is why it does not appear
in the pub

luded wholesale by `release/publish.ps1`**, which is why it does not appear
in the published bundle.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The plugin imports only Node builtins — profile-installed bundles resolve no third-party packages. T
he hand-written Standard Schema in `plugin/config/schema.js` implements the exact `~standard.validat
e` interface Cordis requires (the official docs use `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`; a hand-written schem
a is used here to keep the bundle dependency-free).
`release/` holds the release tooling. Eight checks — seven scripts, `check-runtime` runs twice (this
repo, then `review/`) — each able to fail:
| check | refuses when |
| `check-consistency.mjs` | the configuration table, the docs' path references, the retired vocabula

ry or the two copies of the bundled skill disagree with their single source |
| `check-preset-sync.m
js` | a row upstream's `standard` preset carries is missing here (it needs a DSH checkout — `--sourc

e <dir>` or `$DSH_SOURCE` — and skips cleanly without one) |
| `check-public-surface.mjs` | this rep

o's own public files trip the mode's privacy guard |
| `check-runtime.mjs` | the skill frontmatter o

r the `customSkillDirs` target does not resolve (run twice: the repo, then `review/`) |
| `check-cha

ngelog.mjs` | `package.json`'s version has no `CHANGELOG.md` entry |
| `check-prompt-variables.mjs`
| the preset text names a `{{…}}` variable the host does not register (the source of truth is read f

rom a git tag, not a working tree) |
